display.purpose: Used for the image-led homepage hero and large place-focused headings.

body.purpose: Used for navigation, body copy, controls, and compact evidence labels.

label.purpose: Short tracked uppercase section labels; not long-form or essential instructions.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Occasional elevated drawers and menus; keep the editorial page mostly flat.

shadows.name: map-pin
shadows.purpose: Keeps white map-pin markers legible against map content.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Small color and position feedback on interactive controls.

motion.name: editorial-reveal
motion.purpose: Subtle opacity and 16px vertical reveal for content entering view.

motion.name: hero-entry
motion.purpose: Staggered, small vertical entrance for hero copy and actions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Near-zero animation and transition duration; reveal content immediately
motion.purpose: Honors prefers-reduced-motion while keeping all content available.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Direct next steps such as Explore Japan; compact, high-contrast, and visible to keyboard users.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-accent); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.99); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter alternative action, used for context or secondary discovery paths.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 43 48 / 20%); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: rgb(32 43 48 / 50%); background: rgb(32 43 48 / 5%); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(.99); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A clearly outlined, labeled field used in search and preference forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Search places<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="A city or interest" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 43 48 / 20%); border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(32 43 48 / 45%); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(150 59 43 / 15%); }

components.name: Public Navigation
components.description: Sticky public navigation with simple links and a clear exploration action.
components.html: DiscoverExperiencesDestinationsHow It Works
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(32 43 48 / 10%); background: rgb(247 245 239 / 95%); color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-nav a { color: rgb(32 43 48 / 80%); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-accent); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 1023px) { .ds-nav { gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; } }

components.name: Source Status Badge
components.description: Text-bearing verification or freshness status; meaning stays clear without color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 43 48 / 15%); background: var(--color-background); color: rgb(32 43 48 / 75%); font: 600 10px/1.4 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-badge[data-status="stale"] { border-color: rgb(139 75 47 / 30%); background: #f6e9e0; color: #733821; }

components.name: External Experience Card
components.description: Informational operator listing with provenance and official link; not a MICHI booking card.

components.css: .ds-experience-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(32 43 48 / 10%); background: #fff; color: var(--color-foreground); transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-experience-card:hover { border-color: rgb(32 43 48 / 30%); } .ds-experience-card__title { display: flex; min-height: 208px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(32 43 48 / 10%); background: var(--color-surface-muted); } .ds-experience-card__title p { color: var(--color-accent); font: 700 10px/1.4 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: .19em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-experience-card__title h3 { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 400 30px/1.2 var(--font-serif); } .ds-experience-card__body { display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-experience-card__body span { color: var(--color-accent); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Photo Credit
components.description: Adjacent attribution links for the creator and license of documentary imagery.
components.html: Photo: Creator · License · cropped for layout
components.css: .ds-photo-credit { color: rgb(32 43 48 / 70%); font: 400 12px/1.65 var(--font-sans); } .ds-photo-credit a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-photo-credit a:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-photo-credit a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
MICHI's implemented public experience pairs the calm reading rhythm of a travel journal with the clarity of an evidence-led discovery product. Warm paper, deep ink, restrained vermilion, generous image space, and editorial serif headings make Japan and its places the focus. The traveler discovery journey leads; responsible recommendations are the signature next step, and guest browsing is useful before sign-in.

The current public homepage opens with a documentary Kenrokuen Garden photograph, visible credit, and direct discovery actions, then moves into real destination choices and responsible-travel context. Source status, booking distinctions, and missing evidence are stated where they matter. This document records the frontend system in code; it is not a visual approval of the homepage capture. Host, DMO, and admin dashboards are not represented as redesigned here.
keyCharacteristics: Image-led travel storytelling with place, creator, and license context.
Warm neutral surfaces and confident, readable ink typography.
Direct public exploration before account creation.
Factual states and provenance remain visible in the interface.

rules.name: The Evidence Stays Legible Rule
rules.body: Color never carries verification, health, warning, or booking meaning by itself; use a text label or accessible icon as well.

dos: Do keep public discovery useful to guests before sign-in.
Do use the verified Kenrokuen image with its adjacent linked creator and license credit; use only verified, attributed documentary imagery for real places.
Do preserve source, verification, freshness, and booking distinctions close to the decision they inform.
Do keep unavailable destination-health evidence explicitly unavailable.
Do honor visible keyboard focus and `prefers-reduced-motion`; make content available without entrance animation.
Do pair status colors with text or accessible icon labels.
donts: Don't use generated concept artwork as factual destination, operator, or activity photography.
Don't present external listings as bookable through MICHI without host authorization and real capacity.
Don't present principles as measured community outcomes or fabricate destination health, inventory, access, or partnerships.
Don't use stereotypical Japanese motifs or generic AI-dashboard styling as visual shorthand.
Don't turn every group of content into a rounded, floating card.
